session.title: Paste your Hungryroot session
session.description:
{reason}

1. On a computer, open Chrome and log in at hungryroot.com.
2. Press F12 (Mac: Cmd+Option+I) to open Developer Tools.
3. Click the **Network** tab, then reload the page.
4. In the filter box type `api.hungryroot.com` and click any row in the list.
5. Under **Headers** → **Request Headers**, find **cookie**. Right-click its value → **Copy value**.
6. Paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: Hungryroot didn't accept that email and password. If they're right, go back and choose "Paste a session" instead.
error.invalid_session: That session didn't work. Make sure you're logged in on hungryroot.com and copied the whole cookie value.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Hungryroot. Try again in a minute.

api_changed.title: Hungryroot changed their website
api_changed.description:
The Hungryroot integration got an answer it doesn't understand ({detail}). Some sensors may be empty until it's updated.

To fix: go to Settings → Updates (or Settings → Marketplace → Hungryroot) and install the latest version. If there's no update yet, download diagnostics from Settings → Devices & services → Hungryroot → ⋮ → Download diagnostics, and hand that file to whoever maintains the integration.
